changes.summary: For the first time in France, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs presents the work of Brazilian photographer Rafael Pavarotti from October 2, 2026, to May 2, 2027. The exhibition showcases over 200 prints, juxtaposed with photographs from the museum’s collection, from the iconic fashion magazine covers to portraits of international pop culture stars such as Rihanna, Harry Styles, and Beyoncé, as well as campaigns he has created for major fashion houses. His work is characterized by a vibrant, powerful style, producing striking and unique images. Born in 1993 in Pará, within the Amazon rainforest, Pavarotti’s personal history resonates throughout his photographic approach. Strong women in his family, the bright, colorful dishware of his grandmother, and the natural environment of his childhood are central sources of inspiration.
